title: Hostile-probe repository is contained by the container-class sandbox
decision_served: DEC-18(b): whether repository code may run in the container-class sandbox
method: A synthetic hostile repository built by the test (never a real repository) is run in real containers through the real driver and the real allow-list docker proxy against the local Docker daemon. The attacker view (probe.js) and the host view (listener hits, leftovers, seeded canaries, process counts) are both checked.

K.description: third-party scanners: no NIC, repo read-only, no key, no execution

K-exec.description: build/test probe: the package mirror only, no gateway key, repo code runs

attempts.attempt: plant a factory canary (AISDLC_CANARY_ pattern) into /out
attempts.expected: the output scan fires and /out is withheld (quarantined)

attempts.expected: the output scan fires on the logs too, and /out is withheld

attempts.attempt: 4 factory canaries seeded where a sandbox must not reach (host process env, a host file beside the scratch root, the gateway peer env, the mirror peer env) searched for in every sandbox's /out, stdout and stderr
attempts.expected: none found

attempts.attempt: spawn processes in a loop until the system says no (limit 64 pids)
attempts.expected: stops below the pids limit with EAGAIN

attempts.attempt: a real fork bomb :(){ :|:& };:
attempts.expected: capped at 64 pids; the container is killed at the time limit or exits; the host process count returns to normal
attempts.observed: status killed, host process count change 0, container removed

attempts.attempt: allocate and touch memory without end (limit 128 MiB, no swap)
attempts.expected: killed by the kernel before 128 MiB is passed; the run is void or exits by signal
attempts.observed: status oom_killed, exit null, last progress 64 MiB

attempts.attempt: sleep for 600 s (limit 3 s)
attempts.expected: killed at the limit (status timed_out), the container is removed, the run returns promptly

attempts.session: K-exec (out 1 MiB, work 8 MiB) / node probe.js fill
attempts.attempt: write 1 GiB each to /out, /work and /tmp
attempts.expected: ENOSPC at the cap (/out 1 MiB, /work 8 MiB, /tmp 8 MiB)

attempts.attempt: leave symlinks in /out to /etc/passwd, /proc/1/environ and ../../etc/shadow, and a hard link to /etc/hostname
attempts.expected: links are skipped, never followed; only regular files are returned

attempts.attempt: look for files an earlier hostile session wrote (/tmp, /work, the working copy) and for the host scratch directory
attempts.expected: none exist (tmpfs is gone with the container; the host path is not mounted)
attempts.observed: exists: /tmp false, /work false, working copy false, host scratch false
